The reverse DCF starts with FY2025 consolidated operating cash flow less purchases of property, plant and equipment, a free-cash-flow proxy of [₩33.7bn](#evidence-ev_e773e665c48dd1c549ee8b445f0b0dc1). It uses [20.0 million listed shares](#evidence-ev_ca94af67a923a68cd65f28c5882a700b) and FY2025 net borrowings of [₩53.8bn](#evidence-ev_c5fb34842435ace5fa156d3a1573a214) to bridge from the share price to business value.

On the same cash-flow basis, Solsup grew at [10.03% a year](#evidence-ev_7e381b1a3c259b4b76ce1387d4640b1e) from FY2020 to FY2025. **None of the nine scenarios requires Solsup to repeat that pace.** That is a comparison with history, not a forecast: the implied rate depends on the discount rate, perpetual growth and how representative FY2025 cash flow was.
